title: Update website color scheme to pastel colors

requirements.text: Replace the current vibrant gradient color scheme (coral/orange to purple/pink) with a soft pastel color palette throughout the entire website, including backgrounds, buttons, text highlights, and accent colors

quotes: can you make the website in pastel colours

acceptanceCriteria: All vibrant gradients are replaced with soft pastel colors
Color palette maintains consistency across all pages and components
Pastel colors provide sufficient contrast for readability
UI elements like buttons, inputs, and cards use pastel color variations

constraints: Maintain the existing clean, study-focused interface layout
Preserve the modern sans-serif typography and readability optimizations
Keep the generous whitespace and clear visual hierarchy intact
nonGoals: Changing the functional behavior of any components
Modifying the layout structure or spacing
Altering typography choices beyond color adjustments
